purpose: Source integrity audit only; no signals, prices selected for entry, outcomes, orders or profit estimates
selection: Already cached sixth file only; audit all records without PnL or strategy-based selection
epoch: A snapshot with seq1 after a prior seq greater than1 starts a new inferred channel epoch. Reused shard/sid alone never preserves old ticker initialization. Duplicate seq1 or any other sequence gap invalidates channel until a later explicit seq1 snapshot; epoch is inferred, not an observed connection UUID.
snapshot: Independently reconstruct full ladders from snapshot_yes_bids and snapshot_no_bids. A ticker must have a snapshot in the current inferred epoch before any delta is accepted.
delta: Require raw side, price, quantity, reported before and after to agree with reconstructed ladder; compare top3 displayed YES and NO bids and complementary asks to independently reconstructed values.
quantity_absolute_tolerance: 0.000001 contracts for serialized binary float arithmetic only, fixed before audit results; exact price equality; no negative quantities accepted
clock: Do not reorder or alter source timestamps. Report global and within-channel regressions separately. No execution chronology claim from successful state reconstruction.
